evidence: Labeled Tests, introduces test/with_sanitizer_env.py.in, and updates test_framework.py, test_runner.py, and fuzz/test_runner.py to configure sanitizer defaults.
rationale: Enables TSan adaptive delay by default and centralizes duplicated sanitizer configuration across test runners. According to the PR description, enabling adaptive delay 'may help to find some kind of rare races more frequently', providing worthwhile improvements to test signal without fixing an immediate blocking bug.
